item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: shastryassociates_gt5q5x
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://themes.muffingroup.com/be/language4.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where we send your data

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

Who We Are

About SAGE

SAGE (Shastry Associates Global Enterprises) is an international group of highly qualified and accomplished engineers and entrepreneurs with a long track record of engineering and technology experience in industry and academia.

Their knowledge is very well rooted both in the fundamentals of electronics and communication engineering in general and in applied electromagnetics, RF circuits and antennas, and wireless communication systems in particular.

SAGE associates are also excellent communicators. They disseminate knowledge through courses, tutorials, and workshops to provide a deep understanding of the subject matter and insights therein, as well as guidelines for design and applications of the theory.

We provide training, consulting, customized courses, tutorials, and workshops on demand, tailored to meet your specific needs.

SAGE associates are also excellent communicators. They disseminate knowledge through courses, tutorials, and workshops to provide a deep understanding of the subject matter and insights therein, as well as guidelines for design and applications of the theory.

We provide training, consulting, customized courses, tutorials, and workshops on demand, tailored to meet your specific needs.

Core Competencies

Our team brings together decades of experience across multiple engineering disciplines

Deep expertise in the fundamentals of electronics and communication systems, providing comprehensive solutions.

Specialized

Advanced

Industry Leader

Member IEEE , Member Sigma Xi, is a Professor of microwave and wireless engineering in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Bradley University, Peoria, Illinois

❖He is also the founder of Shastry Associates Group Enterprise (SAGE).

❖Since joining Bradley in 1991, he spearheaded development of the curriculum, laboratories, and an active research program in the area of microwave and wireless engineering. He established a National Science Foundation - supported advanced microwave engineering laboratory for testing MMICs, an anechoic chamber for antenna measurements, and microwave integrated circuit fabrication facility.

❖His areas of research are: wideband distributed amplifiers and distributed architecture active circuits, reconfigurable circuits and printed antennas, wideband circuits and antennas, wireless power transfer, and ambient RF energy -harvesting. He has made significant contributions in his area of expertise in Industry -University collaborative projects.

❖He served as director of RF development at Validus Technologies from 2006 -2014. He has advised Endotronix, Inc since it’s up -start stage. He is an advisor for Center for Antennas and RF Systems, MSRIT, and ELDASS, Bangalore.

❖He earned his Ph.D in microwave engineering from IIT-Bombay in 1980; invented the widely-used Linearly Tapered Slotline Antenna (LTSA) during his doctoral research. He has M.Tech  (Microwave and Radar
Engineering) degree from IIT -Kharagpur and B . E (Electronics) degree from Bangalore University. He received Post-Doctoral Fellowship from the University of Wisconsin, Madison, in 1982, where he made pioneering research contributions to the area of Wideband Distributed Amplifiers. He worked as a senior scientist at LRDE, Bangalore (1980- 82) and at DRDL, Hyderabad (1974 -75). Dr. Shastry is the author/ co­author of over hundred manuscripts and publications. He holds 2 US patents on Electronically Tunable Active Duplexers. He has supervised numerous graduate and undergraduate student projects for nearly forty years. He has served as reviewer for IEEE Transactions and other international journals, international conferences and books. He has served on expert review panels of National Science Foundation, U.S.A. He has been recognized for h is outstanding performance in teaching and exemplary innovations in the field of microwave engineering by IETE, India, and Bradley University.

❖Dr. Prasad Shastry , FIETE, Sr.

Member IEEE , Member Sigma Xi, is a Professor of microwave and wireless engineering in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Bradley University, Peoria, Illinois

❖He is also the founder of Shastry Associates Group Enterprise (SAGE).

❖Since joining Bradley in 1991, he spearheaded development of the curriculum, laboratories, and an active research program in the area of microwave and wireless engineering. He established a National Science Foundation - supported advanced microwave engineering laboratory for testing MMICs, an anechoic chamber for antenna measurements, and microwave integrated circuit fabrication facility.

❖His areas of research are: wideband distributed amplifiers and distributed architecture active circuits, reconfigurable circuits and printed antennas, wideband circuits and antennas, wireless power transfer, and ambient RF energy -harvesting. He has made significant contributions in his area of expertise in Industry -University collaborative projects.

❖He served as director of RF development at Validus Technologies from 2006 -2014. He has advised Endotronix, Inc since it’s up -start stage. He is an advisor for Center for Antennas and RF Systems, MSRIT, and ELDASS, Bangalore.

❖He earned his Ph.D in microwave engineering from IIT-Bombay in 1980; invented the widely-used Linearly Tapered Slotline Antenna (LTSA) during his doctoral research. He has M.Tech  (Microwave and Radar
Engineering) degree from IIT -Kharagpur and B . E (Electronics) degree from Bangalore University. He received Post-Doctoral Fellowship from the University of Wisconsin, Madison, in 1982, where he made pioneering research contributions to the area of Wideband Distributed Amplifiers. He worked as a senior scientist at LRDE, Bangalore (1980- 82) and at DRDL, Hyderabad (1974 -75). Dr. Shastry is the author/ co­author of over hundred manuscripts and publications. He holds 2 US patents on Electronically Tunable Active Duplexers. He has supervised numerous graduate and undergraduate student projects for nearly forty years. He has served as reviewer for IEEE Transactions and other international journals, international conferences and books. He has served on expert review panels of National Science Foundation, U.S.A. He has been recognized for h is outstanding performance in teaching and exemplary innovations in the field of microwave engineering by IETE, India, and Bradley University.

❖Dr. Prasad Shastry , FIETE, Sr.

❖Krishna Katragadda has more than 15 years of Industry experience in the development of RF/Antenna systems for smartphones, IoT and other consumer devices and is currently working as a Staff Hardware engineer at Google LLC, USA.

❖Krishna earned Master's degree from Bradley University, Peoria, USA and Bachelors degree from Koneru Lakshmaiah College of Engineering, Guntur, India.

❖Krishna during his Masters education at Bradley University did extensive research in the areas of Electromagnetics, Radio Frequency and microwave engineering. As part of his research, he designed a “ Reconfigurable Aperture Coupled Multiband Patch antenna “.

❖Krishna started his career as an Antenna Design Engineer at Motorola Mobility. During his tenure from 2005 - 2015 he designed and integrated antenna systems for 20 Motorola Mobile phones for 2G/3G/4G technologies. Notable products include Google NEXUS 6, Moto z, Moto x Gen1 and Gen2, DROID 4, DROID BIONIC, DROID X, RAZR V6.

❖Krishna currently is part of Google Pixel Hardware team and leads antenna design for Pixel Smartphones.

❖Krishna has presented and published multiple technical papers and holds 2 Patents.

https://shastryassociates.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/aparna.png#1502 https://shastryassociates.websitemaker.site/wp-content/uploads/sites/141/2022/12/Picture1.jpg

❖Aparna holds a Bachelor’s degree in EEE from SRM Easwari Engineering College

❖She earned her Master’s degree in RF and Microwave Engineering (with specialization in Antennas) from Bradley University, Peoria, Illinois, USA in the year 2007.

❖Her Master’s thesis was on the design of a frequency reconfigurable coplanar patch antenna. She has published and presented papers in the European Microwave Conference and IEEE International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation.

❖She worked at Validus Technologies, LLC, in East Peoria, Illinois, USA as an RF Design Engineer and in an Aarjay International in Bangalore, India, as a Application engineer before joining Verdant.

❖Aparna, currently leads the Antenna Design group at Verdant Telemetry and Antenna Systems Pvt. Ltd., Kochi, focusing on design of airborne antennas for the military & defense sector, where she has 10+ years of experience.

❖At Verdant, she had developed many different types of airborne antennas like spirals, horns, dipoles, monopole blades, bicones etc., for various applications like Electronic warfare, Jamming, Radio Altimeter, GPS, Direction finding, communication, navigation among others.

❖Her contribution in an antenna design had fetched the best indigenization award for IAF (Indian Air Force)  in the year 2017.

❖Aparna holds a Bachelor’s degree in EEE from SRM Easwari Engineering College

❖She earned her Master’s degree in RF and Microwave Engineering (with specialization in Antennas) from Bradley University, Peoria, Illinois, USA in the year 2007.

❖Her Master’s thesis was on the design of a frequency reconfigurable coplanar patch antenna. She has published and presented papers in the European Microwave Conference and IEEE International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation.

❖She worked at Validus Technologies, LLC, in East Peoria, Illinois, USA as an RF Design Engineer and in an Aarjay International in Bangalore, India, as a Application engineer before joining Verdant.

❖Aparna, currently leads the Antenna Design group at Verdant Telemetry and Antenna Systems Pvt. Ltd., Kochi, focusing on design of airborne antennas for the military & defense sector, where she has 10+ years of experience.

❖At Verdant, she had developed many different types of airborne antennas like spirals, horns, dipoles, monopole blades, bicones etc., for various applications like Electronic warfare, Jamming, Radio Altimeter, GPS, Direction finding, communication, navigation among others.

❖Her contribution in an antenna design had fetched the best indigenization award for IAF (Indian Air Force)  in the year 2017.

❖Balamurugan Sundaram has more than 15 years of experience in the development of RF/analog electronic systems for medical, industrial and commercial applications and is currently working as a Senior Principal Engineer at Endotronix Inc, a medical device company focusing on proactive heart failure management system.

❖Having a serious passion for engineering, he graduated top of his class as an electrical engineer from Kongu Engineering College, India in the year 2000, where he earned the “Best Student” award along with a gold medal.

❖During his Masters education at Bradley University, USA he did extended research in the area of Radio Frequency and microwave engineering. As part of his research, he designed a novel active duplexer circuit that can be used for enhancing range in a cellular device. The research was published in peer reviewed international journals and conferences. As a co-inventor of the concept two US patents have been granted on this idea. Bala Sundaram received his MSEE at Bradley University, USA in the year 2005.

❖Bala Sundaram started his engineering career as an RF Design Engineer at Validus Technologies, Peoria, Illinois, USA where his major roles included problem solving, design, simulation, testing and debugging electronic circuits and systems. During this role he was involved in innovating a novel microwave antennae (2.4 to 18GHz) capable of heating specific depths inside the renal artery for solving chronic hypertension, design and testing a 2.3GHz Tunable Active Duplexer, designing a 9-11GHz IF Amplifier MMIC, designing and testing a 2.4GHz Long Range ZigBee Wireless Module, designing and testing a 2.2GHz RF Soot sensor, innovating a novel wireless Swing position sensor for Excavators and designing and testing of a novel 125KHz magnetically coupled RFID system for heavy machinery.

❖At Validus, Bala Sundaram was involved in the development of Endotronix wireless sensor-reader system which was aiming at enabling patients to conveniently measure PA pressure using an easy-to-use handheld device. As part of the implantable sensor, he has been involved in the design, simulation and sensor behavior inside human body. As part of the external wireless reader, he has been involved in design, fabrication and testing of its various components such as antenna, transmit receive circuit, phase locked loop circuit, and an FPGA based timing circuit.

❖In 2014 Bala Sundaram started his career as a product development engineer at Endotronix where he was engaged full-time to enable the wireless sensor-reader concept into a reality. His contributions towards the sensor and reader development helped the company achieve successful in-vivo animal study and a successful start of a human study in the year 2017. Bala Sundaram played an active role in meeting all the standards requirements of the product that enabled Endotronix obtain FDA approval to start the human trial in the US. So far Endotronix has successfully implanted more than 100 patients worldwide and has acquired more than 75 million dollars in funding.

❖Bala Sundaram has presented and published his technical papers in prestigious international conferences and journals and holds more than 20 US and International Patents on various innovations.

❖Balamurugan Sundaram has more than 15 years of experience in the development of RF/analog electronic systems for medical, industrial and commercial applications and is currently working as a Senior Principal Engineer at Endotronix Inc, a medical device company focusing on proactive heart failure management system.

❖Having a serious passion for engineering, he graduated top of his class as an electrical engineer from Kongu Engineering College, India in the year 2000, where he earned the “Best Student” award along with a gold medal.

❖During his Masters education at Bradley University, USA he did extended research in the area of Radio Frequency and microwave engineering. As part of his research, he designed a novel active duplexer circuit that can be used for enhancing range in a cellular device. The research was published in peer reviewed international journals and conferences. As a co-inventor of the concept two US patents have been granted on this idea. Bala Sundaram received his MSEE at Bradley University, USA in the year 2005.

❖Bala Sundaram started his engineering career as an RF Design Engineer at Validus Technologies, Peoria, Illinois, USA where his major roles included problem solving, design, simulation, testing and debugging electronic circuits and systems. During this role he was involved in innovating a novel microwave antennae (2.4 to 18GHz) capable of heating specific depths inside the renal artery for solving chronic hypertension, design and testing a 2.3GHz Tunable Active Duplexer, designing a 9-11GHz IF Amplifier MMIC, designing and testing a 2.4GHz Long Range ZigBee Wireless Module, designing and testing a 2.2GHz RF Soot sensor, innovating a novel wireless Swing position sensor for Excavators and designing and testing of a novel 125KHz magnetically coupled RFID system for heavy machinery.

❖At Validus, Bala Sundaram was involved in the development of Endotronix wireless sensor-reader system which was aiming at enabling patients to conveniently measure PA pressure using an easy-to-use handheld device. As part of the implantable sensor, he has been involved in the design, simulation and sensor behavior inside human body. As part of the external wireless reader, he has been involved in design, fabrication and testing of its various components such as antenna, transmit receive circuit, phase locked loop circuit, and an FPGA based timing circuit.

❖In 2014 Bala Sundaram started his career as a product development engineer at Endotronix where he was engaged full-time to enable the wireless sensor-reader concept into a reality. His contributions towards the sensor and reader development helped the company achieve successful in-vivo animal study and a successful start of a human study in the year 2017. Bala Sundaram played an active role in meeting all the standards requirements of the product that enabled Endotronix obtain FDA approval to start the human trial in the US. So far Endotronix has successfully implanted more than 100 patients worldwide and has acquired more than 75 million dollars in funding.

❖Bala Sundaram has presented and published his technical papers in prestigious international conferences and journals and holds more than 20 US and International Patents on various innovations.

⮚Dr. Boopalan Ganapathy is an Associate Professor in the School of Electronics Engineering at Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore, Tamil Nādu, India.  He was awarded a Ph.D. degree in electronics engineering by VIT in 2020.

⮚During his doctoral research, he analyzed the possibility of using metamaterials for wireless power transfer. 

⮚He earned an M.S degree in ICT from MIT, Anna University, Chennai in 2002, Bachelor of Engineering (ECE) degree from Madras University in 1997, and a Diploma in Electrical Engineering at CPT, Taramani in 1994.

⮚He has 13 years of experience in teaching for both undergraduate and postgraduate students.

⮚Also instrumental in establishing lab on embedded systems and upgrading Microwave lab at VIT from 2009.

⮚He worked at Pico Mega Design Labs, Chennai for 7 years as a Sr. Design Engineer.  During his tenure from 2002 – 2009 part of the team in PMDL that designed, developed and providing solution for RFID products ranging from Low Frequency to Radio Frequency (both passive and active).

⮚ In 2006, he involved in building a system for wireless energy transfer at 2.45 GHz for Honeywell, Bangalore. 

⮚He has been a member of the team that developed Real Time GPS signal simulator for CABS, Bangalore during 1998 – 2002.  

⮚His areas of interest are the following: reconfigurable intelligent surface, antennas, active and passive circuits, metasurfaces, plasmonics, wireless energy harvesting for IoT and Wireless power transfer.

⮚He has published more than 15 publications that includes SCI journal articles, refereed conference papers.  He has supervised numerous undergraduate and post-graduate projects and thesis for over 13 years. 

⮚He is a member of IEEE Antenna and Propagation Society (AP-S).

Dr. M.H.Kori is one of the leading Wireless & Mobile Telecommunication & RF experts. He has more than 40 year's experience in Telecom, RF, Microelectronics & IT.

His research, industrial and academic experiences include work at Alcatel-Lucent Technologies as Technical Director & also as Head of Hyderabad R&D Unit; Head of Wireless Division C-DOT; VP Geosoft Technologies; Head Telecom DSQ Software; IIT Bombay; University of Duisburg, Germany; Advisor Validus Technologies USA, Consultant Telecom Standards Development Society India (TSDSI).

His Professional Contributions include extensive research work in Wireless & Mobile Communications, head of architecture team in Lucent Technologies working on many technologies leading to 5G; Digital Microwave development at C-DOT; Visiting Fellow at Uni- versity of Duisburg Germany, designed MMIC Chips fabricated at Daimler Benz MMIC Foundry, Germany; Member of several adviso- ry & standards committees - Study Group NWG 9 of ITU-R; guided students for MS/PhD at IISc/BITS & other Institutes; Member of Advisory Committee / Academic Council for many Institutes / Universities.

He published and presented many papers in Journals & Conferences, conducted workshops at National & International Conferences, has been the Chair, Co-Chair of several Conferences, Co-author, Contributing Editor and Co-editor of Books, Conference Proceedings.

His recent Invited Talks include talks at IEEE Panel Discussion on 5G for India, Invited Talk on 5G at International GIFSI Workshop. He is the Organizing Chair of the International Radar Symposium and International Symposium on Microwaves.

Dr Kori is one of the Vice Presidents of IETE, past TPC Chair, past Chair IETE Bangalore Centre, immediate past Chair of International Microelectronics & Packaging Society (IMAPS) India, past Vice Chair of IEEE MTT & ED Society, past EC Member IET. He is the recipient of RVCE World Telecom Day Award & IETE Batra Memorial Award.
Dr Kori is a Distinguished Fellow of IETE. His Areas of interest include Wireless Communications, Beyond 5G, loT; RF & MMIC; Microelectronics. Dr Kori holds PhD from IIT Bombay.

Dr. M.H.Kori is one of the leading Wireless & Mobile Telecommunication & RF experts. He has more than 40 year's experience in Telecom, RF, Microelectronics & IT.

His research, industrial and academic experiences include work at Alcatel-Lucent Technologies as Technical Director & also as Head of Hyderabad R&D Unit; Head of Wireless Division C-DOT; VP Geosoft Technologies; Head Telecom DSQ Software; IIT Bombay; University of Duisburg, Germany; Advisor Validus Technologies USA, Consultant Telecom Standards Development Society India (TSDSI).

His Professional Contributions include extensive research work in Wireless & Mobile Communications, head of architecture team in Lucent Technologies working on many technologies leading to 5G; Digital Microwave development at C-DOT; Visiting Fellow at Uni- versity of Duisburg Germany, designed MMIC Chips fabricated at Daimler Benz MMIC Foundry, Germany; Member of several adviso- ry & standards committees - Study Group NWG 9 of ITU-R; guided students for MS/PhD at IISc/BITS & other Institutes; Member of Advisory Committee / Academic Council for many Institutes / Universities.

He published and presented many papers in Journals & Conferences, conducted workshops at National & International Conferences, has been the Chair, Co-Chair of several Conferences, Co-author, Contributing Editor and Co-editor of Books, Conference Proceedings.

His recent Invited Talks include talks at IEEE Panel Discussion on 5G for India, Invited Talk on 5G at International GIFSI Workshop. He is the Organizing Chair of the International Radar Symposium and International Symposium on Microwaves.

Dr Kori is one of the Vice Presidents of IETE, past TPC Chair, past Chair IETE Bangalore Centre, immediate past Chair of International Microelectronics & Packaging Society (IMAPS) India, past Vice Chair of IEEE MTT & ED Society, past EC Member IET. He is the recipient of RVCE World Telecom Day Award & IETE Batra Memorial Award.

vDr. M.H.Kori is one of the leading Wireless & Mobile Telecommunication & RF experts. He has more than 40 year’s experience in Telecom, RF, Microelectronics & IT.

vHis research, industrial and academic experiences include work at Alcatel-Lucent Technologies as Technical Director & also as Head of Hyderabad R&D Unit; Head of Wireless Division C-DOT; VP Geosoft Technologies; Head Telecom DSQ Software; IIT Bombay; University of Duisburg, Germany; Advisor Validus Technologies USA, Consultant Telecom Standards Development Society India (TSDSI).

vHis Professional Contributions include extensive research work in Wireless & Mobile Communications, head of architecture team in Lucent Technologies working on many technologies leading to 5G;

vDigital Microwave development at C-DOT; Visiting Fellow at University of Duisburg Germany, designed MMIC Chips fabricated at Daimler Benz MMIC Foundry, Germany; Member of several advisory & standards committees – Study Group NWG 9 of ITU-R; guided students for MS/PhD at IISc/BITS & other Institutes; Member of Advisory Committee / Academic Council for many Institutes / Universities.

vHe published and presented many papers in Journals & Conferences, conducted workshops at National & International Conferences, has been the Chair, Co-Chair of several Conferences, Co-author, Contributing Editor and Co-editor of Books, Conference Proceedings.

vHis recent Invited Talks include talks at IEEE Panel Discussion on 5G for India, Invited Talk on 5G at International GIFSI Workshop. He is the Organizing Chair of the International Radar Symposium and International Symposium on Microwaves.

vDr Kori is one of the Vice Presidents of IETE, past TPC Chair, past Chair IETE Bangalore Centre, immediate past Chair of International Microelectronics & Packaging Society (IMAPS) India, past Vice Chair of IEEE MTT & ED Society, past EC Member IET. He is the recipient of RVCE World Telecom Day Award & IETE Batra Memorial Award.

vDr Kori is a Distinguished Fellow of IETE. His Areas of interest include Wireless Communications, Beyond 5G, IoT; RF & MMIC; Microelectronics. Dr Kori holds PhD from IIT Bombay.

⮚Dr. S. Raghavan Professor (H.A.G.) (presently VISITING FACULTY) in Electronics and Communication Engineering Department, National Institute of Technology (N.I.T.), Trichy

⮚He has about 40 years of teaching and research experience.

⮚His interest includes Microwave Integrated Circuits, BioMedical Engineering, RF MEMS, BioMEMS, Metamaterial, Frequency Selective Surfaces FSS and Microwave Engineering.

⮚A proud research scholar of Prof. Bharathi Bhat and Prof. S K Koul, CARE, IIT Delhi. Has established state of the art Microwave Integrated Circuit and Microwave Laboratory in N.I.T., Trichy with the help of Govt. of India funding.

⮚Won Best Teacher award twice and conferred with Honorary Fellowship of Ancient Sciences and Archaeological Society of India, His first Research Scholar Dr.T.Shanmughanantham earned a Gold medal for the best Thesis of the year.

⮚He is also a Short time visiting Fellow in California State University, North Ridge, USA. He has been awarded to conduct Tutorial in APEMC 2010, Beijing, China.

⮚Organizing Chair of ‘Indian Antenna Week 2014’, Chandigarh.

⮚ Invited to be a session chair in PIERS 2013 symposium Taipei, Taiwan. Actively participated in APMC Japan, EuMW Poland and France.

⮚Chair in InCAP 21 and conducted workshop on FSS FILTERS

⮚Has to his credit 150 research papers in national and International Journals, 120 in IEEE Explore, 180 International conferences, and 28 National conferences. Also, filed 3 patents in FSS.

⮚Guided 17 PhD scholars. Senior Member/Fellow in more than 25 international and national Professional Societies including IEEE, BES, IEI, IETE, CSI, TSI, ISTE, ISSS, NPC ISOI, ILA,VEDA, IELTS ,MSRI, and ASI.

⮚Organized various workshops of international importance. His last research scholar Dr.V.Krushnakanth won DARE TO DREAM contest of DRDO and awarded Rs 5 Lakhs by Defence Minister Hon.Rajnanth Singh, Chief of three armed Forces General BIPIN RAWAT, National Security Agency chief Shri Ajit Powal, Defence Secretary Dr Sattish Reddy.

⮚Won IETE national award for his contributions to Microwaves (Smt.Ranjana Pal award), Life time achievement (Microwaves) award by then Chairman ISRO Dr Kiran Kumar.

⮚Patron of the first ever international IEEE conference IMICPW 2019 in NIT Trichy.

⮚His scholars have won many Best paper awards and Best researcher awards His scholar Dr V Krushnakanth has been invited by USA to start the PDF on PASMA FSS.

⮚Has contributed lot in the development of state of the art Library (instrumental in the plan of the new Multistoried Library building as the then Library Coordinator) and Hospital (changed a clinical Dispensary into a 24 Hour hospital as the then Chairman of the Hospital Modernization committee) in NIT-T.

⮚He is an Executive Member of TSI and also in the Tamil Nadu Chapter of TSI.

⮚Also, the founding faculty advisor of IEEE MTT and APS student branch Chapters NIT Trichy.

⮚Dr. S. Raghavan is the author of Microwave Integrated Circuit Components Design through MATLAB CRC Press. He was the President of R.E.C., Trichy Faculty association for 2 years. Made an impact in MICROWAVE ENGINEERING EDUCATION among the student community at large.

vS.Imaculate Rosaline is currently working as Assistant Professor in the department of ECE, Ramaiah Institute of technology,  Bangalore.

⮚

vShe received her UG degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering from J.J College of Engineering and Technology, Trichy, in 2006, PG degree in Communication Systems from Oxford Engineering College, Trichy in 2013.

v

vShe obtained her PhD degree in the area of Metamaterials and Specific Absorption Rate Reduction under the guidance of Dr. S. Raghavan in the department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli, India in 2016.

v

vShe has more than 5 years of teaching experience and 3 years of research experience. Her research interest includes Biological Effects of metamaterials, microwaves in biomedical applications, microwave integrated circuits, planar antennas, smart antennas.

v

vShe has published more than 15 research papers in various international journals and conferences.

vS.Imaculate Rosaline is currently working as Assistant Professor in the department of ECE, Ramaiah Institute of technology,  Bangalore.

⮚

vShe received her UG degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering from J.J College of Engineering and Technology, Trichy, in 2006, PG degree in Communication Systems from Oxford Engineering College, Trichy in 2013.

v

vShe obtained her PhD degree in the area of Metamaterials and Specific Absorption Rate Reduction under the guidance of Dr. S. Raghavan in the department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli, India in 2016.

v

vShe has more than 5 years of teaching experience and 3 years of research experience. Her research interest includes Biological Effects of metamaterials, microwaves in biomedical applications, microwave integrated circuits, planar antennas, smart antennas.

v

vShe has published more than 15 research papers in various international journals and conferences.

❖Dr. Sanjay B. Moghe has more than 40  years of technical and 30  years of management experience in managing development of advanced technology and products.

❖He worked on RF systems for Wireless and Internet applications with  number of large and small companies.

❖He is currently CEO of  RFIC Solutions  a  company based in silicon valley USA and Nagpur India offering design services and IPs  in MMICs covering 0-120 GHz frequencies.

❖He has published over 45 papers in the areas of wireless telecommunication systems, WLAN and BWA systems, low-noise and power amplifiers; microwave integrated circuit ( MIC ) and monolithic microwave integrated circuit ( MMIC ) design techniques and was granted 5 US patents in RFIC and systems areas.

❖He served on the Technical Committees of GaAs IC Symposium and International Microwave and Millimeter wave Monolithic Circuit Symposium. Developed over 600 MMIC and MIC  products for wireless communication and military markets. 

❖He designed some of the earliest MMIC to go into volume production in 1983. Supervised 40 engineers as director of Northrop Grumman's advanced microwave technology group.

❖He worked with Govt. agencies like DARPA, CECOM, US, Air Force etc. on funded research projects totaling to more than $15 Million.

❖He was a member of the founding team at RF Solutions and  Served as President, CTO and member of the board of directors of RF Solutions which was acquired by Anadigics in March 2003. 

❖Dr. Moghe received his B. Sc. And M. Sc. In Degrees in Physics from Delhi University and IIT Bombay. He was granted Ph D degree in electrical engineering from RPI, Troy, New York USA in 1982.

❖Dr. Sanjay B. Moghe has more than 40  years of technical and 30  years of management experience in managing development of advanced technology and products.

❖He worked on RF systems for Wireless and Internet applications with  number of large and small companies.

❖He is currently CEO of  RFIC Solutions  a  company based in silicon valley USA and Nagpur India offering design services and IPs  in MMICs covering 0-120 GHz frequencies.

❖He has published over 45 papers in the areas of wireless telecommunication systems, WLAN and BWA systems, low-noise and power amplifiers; microwave integrated circuit ( MIC ) and monolithic microwave integrated circuit ( MMIC ) design techniques and was granted 5 US patents in RFIC and systems areas.

❖He served on the Technical Committees of GaAs IC Symposium and International Microwave and Millimeter wave Monolithic Circuit Symposium. Developed over 600 MMIC and MIC  products for wireless communication and military markets. 

❖He designed some of the earliest MMIC to go into volume production in 1983. Supervised 40 engineers as director of Northrop Grumman's advanced microwave technology group.

❖He worked with Govt. agencies like DARPA, CECOM, US, Air Force etc. on funded research projects totaling to more than $15 Million.

❖He was a member of the founding team at RF Solutions and  Served as President, CTO and member of the board of directors of RF Solutions which was acquired by Anadigics in March 2003. 

❖Dr. Moghe received his B. Sc. And M. Sc. In Degrees in Physics from Delhi University and IIT Bombay. He was granted Ph D degree in electrical engineering from RPI, Troy, New York USA in 1982.

vDr. Swetha Amit is a motivated and passionate professional with over 15+ years of academic and 9+ years of Research on design and development of Antennas and RF components.

vShe is Co-founder and CEO of Meander Spectra Private Limited which is a DPIIT recognized startup.

vShe has an ongoing project from Defense Innovation Organization as part of Defense India Startup Challenge 2022.

vShe has received her Ph.D. in Electronics Engineering from Jain University, Bangalore in 2018, MTech in Communication systems from R. V. College of Engineering, Bangalore securing Gold Medal in 2009 and B.E from AIT, Chikmagalur in 2005.

vShe has worked as Assistant Professor in the Department of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering, M S Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Bangalore from 2012 to 2021.

vHer research work is on Antenna Design, Wearable and Textile Antenna, SAR analysis and reduction in human body, Liquid antennas, Metamaterials.

vShe has over 35 publications in journals, conferences, patents, book chapters, in addition to funded projects, consultancy and guest lectures.

vMr. Sasidar Vajha has 20 years of experience in product design primarily for the implantable medical industry.

vHe is currently Senior Manager of Electrical and RF group at Livanova, USA Inc.

vHis group is responsible for hardware design, EMC/EMI and MRI compatibility of Neuro stimulation devices for Epilepsy, Depression, and Sleep Apnea.

vPrior to this, he worked on developing RF front ends for Hearing aids, Implantable pacemakers, and Defibrillators.

vHis contributions have resulted in more than 20 devices that are currently in the market in these areas.

vHe earned MSEE from Bradley University and BSEE from Nagarjuna University.

❖Scarlet Daoud is currently a freelance engineering consultant through her own company Eagle-i RF Consulting. She has earned both her Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees in Electrical Engineering from Bradley University, in 1997 and 2004 respectively.  Her graduate studies focus on RF/Microwave and Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit (MMIC) design using GaAs technology.  Scarlet was a member of IEEE from 1999 to 2011 and is a member now since 2014.

❖Scarlet brings 20+ years of combined engineering experience in RF/Microwave integrated circuit design and wireless products, with subject matter expertise in MMIC GaAs technology as well as Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and Wi-Fi. She has worked in diverse industry fields over the years including semiconductors (military applications) and automotive/machinery electronics.

❖Her professional experience started at Rockwell Collins (1998 – 1999) followed by LR Nelson (1999 – 2000), with software and hardware engineering, before working in the semiconductor industry. Scarlet then returned to Bradley University to pursue her master’s degree. She received the foundational experience of designing MMICs through industry sponsored graduate projects, specifically by Fujitsu Semiconductors, Inc. During that time (2000 – 2004), she interned with Fujitsu and her work produced a course report in FET Modeling and her master’s thesis project in “Active Bias, Power Detector, and Voltage Controlled Attenuator MMICs.” From her thesis, a paper was published in IEEE transactions journal that was presented at the 2005 European Microwave Conference (EuMC) in Paris, France.

❖Scarlet worked at ViaSat, Inc., Advanced Microwave Products division, from 2002 through 2011, taking on various roles and responsibilities as MMIC designer and project technical lead. In her design engineer role, Scarlet designed and tested various challenging GaAs MMICs ranging from PAs and LNAs to Attenuators and Phase Shifters, including FET modeling and multi-functionality GaAs MMICs as well as Modules.  All designs encompassed military applications in the frequency ranges of X-band, K-band (both Ku & Ka), and Q-band as well as some L, S, and C band applications. In her project technical lead role, in addition to designing, testing, and leading the project technical team, Scarlet worked along side the program manager and interfaced with the customer, presenting the status of the project technical phases from requirements through delivery.

❖Scarlet worked at Caterpillar from 2012 through 2018, taking on various roles and responsibilities within the two positions of systems engineer and information hardware platform/technical lead engineer. As systems engineer, her responsibilities included technical documentation, software testing of electronic control modules (ECMs), and testing/trouble-shooting of vehicle/machinery ECM networks. As hardware platform/technical lead, Scarlet lead NPI (New Product Introduction) projects for add-on wireless products from conception to production using BLE and Wi-Fi technologies. Responsibilities included technical documentation of various program phases; overseeing electrical (software & hardware), mechanical, environmental, and manufacturing design, test, and build phases; and programmatic logistics with the customer, supplier, and respective technical teams.

❖Scarlet has also worked in the academic field as an Instructor at Bradley University: in the Physics department 2013-2014, and in the Electrical Engineering department 2019-2020. She also has extensive experience in tutoring high school and college level Math and Physics. During the covid-19 pandemic, Scarlet homeschooled both of her sons for the 2020-2021 school year (7th and 8th grade).

❖Scarlet holds one patent and has contributed two publications to the RF/Microwave body of knowledge: 

➢Patent: “Power Efficient Multistage Amplifier and Design Method,” (for MMICs) US2008056714, #7583150 Sep. 2009. Inventors: Kenneth V. Buer, Michael R. Lyons, and Scarlet M. Daoud.

➢Paper: Michael R. Lyons, Christopher D. Grondahl, and Scarlet M. Daoud, “Design of Low-Cost 4W & 6W MMIC High Power Amplifiers for Ka-Band Modules,” in International Microwave Symposium Digest, 2004.

➢Paper: Prasad N. Shastry (S. N. Prasad) and Scarlet M. Daoud, “A Novel Wideband MMIC Voltage Controlled Attenuator with a Bandpass Filter Toplogy,” in IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques Special Issue on 35th European Microwave Conference, Vol. 54, No. 6, June 2006.

❖She is currently in the process of co-authoring an engineering text book on MMIC fundamentals, design, and technology with her colleague Dr. Prasad Shastry.

❖For further details on the diverse roles, responsibilities, and achievements Scarlet has experienced and continues to work on, please refer to her professional profile on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/scarletdaoud/

⮚Shri. V. Mahadevan obtained his B.Tech (Hons) in Electronics & Communication from IIT Kharagpur and M.E. in Communication Engineering from IISc Bangalore. 

⮚     He joined ISRO Satellite Centre in the Communication Systems Group and contributed in the design and development of Antenna & Passive Systems flown in many spacecrafts. 

⮚      One of the major contribution is in the development of Active Phased Array Antennas which was successfully flown and is being adopted for many future spacecrafts. 

⮚      He was appointed as Associated Project Director for CATF (Compact Antenna Test Facility) and the same was established in ISRO Bangalore in a record time.

⮚       He held a number of posts in various satellite projects and finally appointed to the post of Group Director, Communication Systems Group, ISRO Satellite Centre, Bangalore.

⮚       He retired on superannuation in April 2010 and served for about a decade as Professor in the Dept. of Electronics and Communications/ Telecommunication  at PES  University, Bangalore.

⮚        He received NRDC award from Govt. of India for his contribution on Handheld Antenna for Satellite Telephone, Team Award for Cartosat-2 Satellite from

⮚      President of India, ISRO Award for Phased Array Antenna System, and IRSIIETE 2007 Award for Contributions on Spacecraft Omni directional and Phased Array Antenna System.

⮚       He holds two Patents, one Handheld Antenna System and the other on Ultra Low Sidelobe Antenna. 

⮚       He is a Senior Member of IEEE, Life Member ASI (Astronautical Society of India), Life Fellow Member IETE, Distinguished Member ATMS(Antenna Test and Measurement Society) and has published a number of papers in international and national journals.

❖He is a Retired Director SCNPO, ISRO Headquarters

❖Mr Neelakantan holds a

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Electronics from BU (UVCE),
  2. M.Tech from IIT Madras in Communication Systems & RADAR

❖He has served ISRO for 37 years in various capacities from a Systems Engineer to Project Director in the areas of

  1. Satellite Communication,
  2. Satcom Applications,
  3. Ground Station Establishment,
  4. Realisation of Satellites and
  5. In matters related to Satcom Regulations & Policy matters.

❖He retired as Director of Satellite Communication & Navigation Program Office at ISRO Headquarters, Bangalore

❖His Field of Expertise includes

  1. Satellite Communications,
  2. Satellite Systems Engineering and
  3. Satellite Project Management.

❖He is a Life Member of

  1. IETE,
  2. Aeronautical Society of India,
  3. Planet Aerospace
  4. Served in the Academic Council of NIE, Mysore

❖He is in receipt of several Distinguished Awards like from ASI.

❖He has travelled widely in India and abroad for Professional activities and for delivering Technical Talks / Lectures to Professional Bodies and Academic Institutions.

❖His current interest is to spread the knowledge of Space Engineering & Technology to one and all.

❖He is a Retired Director SCNPO, ISRO Headquarters

❖Mr Neelakantan holds a

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Electronics from BU (UVCE),
  2. M.Tech from IIT Madras in Communication Systems & RADAR

❖He has served ISRO for 37 years in various capacities from a Systems Engineer to Project Director in the areas of

  1. Satellite Communication,
  2. Satcom Applications,
  3. Ground Station Establishment,
  4. Realisation of Satellites and
  5. In matters related to Satcom Regulations & Policy matters.

❖He retired as Director of Satellite Communication & Navigation Program Office at ISRO Headquarters, Bangalore

❖His Field of Expertise includes

  1. Satellite Communications,
  2. Satellite Systems Engineering and
  3. Satellite Project Management.

❖He is a Life Member of

  1. IETE,
  2. Aeronautical Society of India,
  3. Planet Aerospace
  4. Served in the Academic Council of NIE, Mysore

❖He is in receipt of several Distinguished Awards like from ASI.

❖He has travelled widely in India and abroad for Professional activities and for delivering Technical Talks / Lectures to Professional Bodies and Academic Institutions.

❖His current interest is to spread the knowledge of Space Engineering & Technology to one and all.

❖M. R. Tripathy is a PhD from the Department of Electronic Science, Delhi University, Delhi, India, since 2000.

❖He worked as a postdoctoral researcher at LPCE, CNRS, Orleans, France, for two years. Apart from this, he has worked as faculty in different engineering colleges in and around Delhi, India.

❖Currently, he is working as Professor in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Amity School of Engineering and Technology, Amity University Uttar Pradesh, Noida, India.

❖He used to organize and chair sessions in PIERS since 2014.

❖He worked as an organizing member of various IEEE and Scopus indexed conferences in India and abroad.

❖He has organized IEEE RFID TA 2021 and IEEE SOLI 2022 as a General Chair.

❖He was the organizing chair of MECON 2022. He has delivered invited talks in Ming-Chi Technical University, New Taipei, Taiwan, Shenzhen University, China, and Chuo University, Tokyo, Japan.

❖He has filed 15 patents and published more than 100 papers in Scopus/SCI indexed conferences and journals. 

❖He has worked as visiting scientist at the University of Gavle, Sweden during May – June 2015 and June – July 2016. He is a senior member of IEEE, URSI, IET, CEng (UK), and a Life member of ISTE and IETE, India. He is the founding chair of the joint chapter of IEEE APS and CRFID, Delhi Section.

❖He is used to be an International Chair of IEEE International Conference on SPIN from 2014 to 2023. He has received Teaching Excellence 2013 Award, Indo-global Education Summit, New Delhi.

❖He is the reviewer of IEEE and other SCI-indexed journals. Present research interest includes Antennas, RF Designs, SDR, Circuits, Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, IoT, and Physical Layers.

❖He has worked as visiting scientist at the University of Gavle, Sweden during May – June 2015 and June – July 2016. He is a senior member of IEEE, URSI, IET, CEng (UK), and a Life member of ISTE and IETE, India. He is the founding chair of the joint chapter of IEEE APS and CRFID, Delhi Section.

❖He is used to be an International Chair of IEEE International Conference on SPIN from 2014 to 2023. He has received Teaching Excellence 2013 Award, Indo-global Education Summit, New Delhi.

❖He is the reviewer of IEEE and other SCI-indexed journals. Present research interest includes Antennas, RF Designs, SDR, Circuits, Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, IoT, and Physical Layers.

❖He worked as a postdoctoral researcher at LPCE, CNRS, Orleans, France, for two years. Apart from this, he has worked as faculty in different engineering colleges in and around Delhi, India.

❖Currently, he is working as Professor in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Amity School of Engineering and Technology, Amity University Uttar Pradesh, Noida, India.

❖He used to organize and chair sessions in PIERS since 2014.

❖He worked as an organizing member of various IEEE and Scopus indexed conferences in India and abroad.

❖He has organized IEEE RFID TA 2021 and IEEE SOLI 2022 as a General Chair.

❖Prof.C.Murali, a distinguished fellow of IETE is an academician and educationist. He received his B.E. degree in electronics from UVCE, Bangalore University and M.E. Degree in electronics from BITS, Pilani.

❖He has more than four decades of academic experience as a lecturer, Asst. Professor, Professor and HoD. He has served various Institutions / Universities as a BoS member, BoE chairman, advisory committee member for UG and PG. He has served M S Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Bangalore for 34 years and Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences, Bangalore as Associate Academic Registrar in Faculty of Engineering & Technology.

❖He has worked as an expert for UPSC, NBA-AICTE and Proficience at IISc. His areas of interest are Microwave Engineering, Computer Networks and Wireless Mobile Networks.

❖He has authored books on Computer Communication Networks and Data Communications & Computer Networks.

❖Prof.Murali is a life member of IETE, ISTE and IMAPS (India). He has served IETE Bangalore centre as EC Member, Joint Secretary, Vice-Chairman and Chairman. He has served IETE, New Delhi as Governing Council member (Three terms), Academic Committee Chairman and Vice President. Under his guidance various activities like syllabus revision, Introduction of CGPA System, publication of Lab manuals, learning materials, dual programs and ISF activities were initiated and successfully executed.

❖Prof.Murali has delivered invited talks, presented technical papers, keynote addresses, reviewed papers, conducted workshops and seminars at IETE, University, state, and National levels.

❖He is associated with an online Journal "Swanirman Sunirmit Publications of Research” as the Chairperson of Career Growth Development and as a member of the Advisory Editorial Board.

Awards received

❖·      Recipient of Dewang Mehta National Educational Award as best professor in Electronics & Communication Engineering in Aug 2017.

❖·      IETE B.R.Batra memorial award 2018. 

❖He has provided consultancy in the development of microwave trainer kits, fabrication of teaching and training aids.

❖He is listed in the directory of Indo-American who is who publication and Biographical international, South Asia publication.

❖His hobbies are reading, photography and philately.

❖Prof.C.Murali, a distinguished fellow of IETE is an academician and educationist. He received his B.E. degree in electronics from UVCE, Bangalore University and M.E. Degree in electronics from BITS, Pilani.

❖He has more than four decades of academic experience as a lecturer, Asst. Professor, Professor and HoD. He has served various Institutions / Universities as a BoS member, BoE chairman, advisory committee member for UG and PG. He has served M S Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Bangalore for 34 years and Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences, Bangalore as Associate Academic Registrar in Faculty of Engineering & Technology.

❖He has worked as an expert for UPSC, NBA-AICTE and Proficience at IISc. His areas of interest are Microwave Engineering, Computer Networks and Wireless Mobile Networks.

❖He has authored books on Computer Communication Networks and Data Communications & Computer Networks.

❖Prof.Murali is a life member of IETE, ISTE and IMAPS (India). He has served IETE Bangalore centre as EC Member, Joint Secretary, Vice-Chairman and Chairman. He has served IETE, New Delhi as Governing Council member (Three terms), Academic Committee Chairman and Vice President. Under his guidance various activities like syllabus revision, Introduction of CGPA System, publication of Lab manuals, learning materials, dual programs and ISF activities were initiated and successfully executed.

❖Prof.Murali has delivered invited talks, presented technical papers, keynote addresses, reviewed papers, conducted workshops and seminars at IETE, University, state, and National levels.

❖He is associated with an online Journal "Swanirman Sunirmit Publications of Research” as the Chairperson of Career Growth Development and as a member of the Advisory Editorial Board.

Awards received

❖·      Recipient of Dewang Mehta National Educational Award as best professor in Electronics & Communication Engineering in Aug 2017.

❖·      IETE B.R.Batra memorial award 2018. 

❖He has provided consultancy in the development of microwave trainer kits, fabrication of teaching and training aids.

❖He is listed in the directory of Indo-American who is who publication and Biographical international, South Asia publication.

❖His hobbies are reading, photography and philately.

At SAGE, we offer various online or on-site workshops in various engineering and technology topics in the areas of Radio Frequency, Millimeter-Wave, Microwave, and Wireless Systems.

Workshops are delivered by our SAGE Team of subject matter experts. The duration of a workshop can vary from short 30 minute sessions to long one hour sessions.

Workshops are available for both college students and experienced industry engineers looking for continued education or refresher purposes.

Currently, this site is under construction and will be updated on a continuous basis as we add more details. Please be sure to keep visiting our page for updates. Feel free to Contact Us for inquiries, requests, and suggestions.

At SAGE, we offer training for operation and usage of different software tools and test and measurement equipment that are specifically used in the design and validation of circuits, components, subsystems and systems for the various areas of Radio Frequency, Millimeter-Wave, Microwave, and Wireless applications.

Training can be delivered by either our SAGE team of experts, or in collaboration with the respective software tools and test equipment company personnel and experts. Delivery options can be hands-on onsite, interactive live web-based media, or online videos with interactive instructor input depending on the nature of training and topics.

Training is available for both college students and experienced industry engineers for continued education or refresher purposes.

Currently, this site is under construction and will be updated on a continuous basis as we add more details. Please be sure to keep visiting our page for updates. Feel free to Contact Us for inquiries, requests, and suggestions.

At SAGE, we offer training for operation and usage of different software tools and test and measurement equipment that are specifically used in the design and validation of circuits, components, subsystems and systems for the various areas of Radio Frequency, Millimeter-Wave, Microwave, and Wireless applications.

Training can be delivered by either our SAGE team of experts, or in collaboration with the respective software tools and test equipment company personnel and experts. Delivery options can be hands-on onsite, interactive live web-based media, or online videos with interactive instructor input depending on the nature of training and topics.

Training is available for both college students and experienced industry engineers for continued education or refresher purposes.

Currently, this site is under construction and will be updated on a continuous basis as we add more details. Please be sure to keep visiting our page for updates. Feel free to Contact Us for inquiries, requests, and suggestions.

SAGE - RVCE - KEYSIGHT Workshop

Workshop

17 - 19 November 2025 | RVCE Campus

Duration: 0 Days
Attendees: 0+
Format: Hands-on
Status: Completed
Download Brochure

About This Event

Master the complete lifecycle of 5G RF power amplifier development in this intensive, hands-on workshop. Participants design, simulate, and fabricate a GaAs FET RF amplifier for 5G frequencies, then return to test real circuits using Keysight professional measurement equipment. Guided by SAGE experts and industry engineers, you'll bridge theory and practice in RF/microwave engineering.

What You'll Learn

  • RF amplifier design principles for 5G frequency bands
  • Circuit simulation and layout creation for tape-out
  • PCB fabrication workflow and component soldering techniques
  • Hands-on testing with Keysight spectrum analyzers and network analyzers
  • S-parameter measurements and performance characterization
  • Industry-standard design-to-deployment methodologies

Who Should Attend

Electronics & Communication students | RF/Microwave engineering researchers | Faculty members teaching analog/RF courses | Industry professionals in wireless communication | Anyone passionate about practical 5G hardware design and development.

SAGE UI/UX Design Challenge – Awards Ceremony.

Event

21st December 2024 | MSRIT, Bengaluru

Duration: 0 Days
Attendees: 0+
Format: Hands-on
Status: Completed
Download Brochure

About This Event

The SAGE UI/UX Design Challenge – Awards Ceremony marks the culmination of an intensive, multi-stage national-level design challenge organized by SAGE. The event celebrates innovation, creativity, and problem-solving excellence demonstrated by student designers across planning, execution, judging, and interview stages.

With participation from 49 teams and 131 students, and evaluation by an international panel of judges from India and the USA, the ceremony recognizes outstanding UI/UX solutions and honors contributors who exemplify design thinking and user-centric innovation.

Event Highlights

  • Multi-phase UI/UX Design Challenge (Planning → Execution → Judging → Interview)
  • Participation from 49 teams and 131 student designers
  • Evaluation by 6 expert judges from India and USA
  • Featured talk on future technologies and design impact
  • Awards, special recognitions, and participation certificates
  • Student–expert interaction and networking

Who Should Attend

Academicians and researchers | Industry professionals | Students of Electronics, Communication and allied disciplines | Entrepreneurs | Anyone interested in India’s technology and innovation ecosystem.

SAGE UI/UX Design Challenge – Awards Ceremony.

Event

21st December 2024 | MSRIT, Bengaluru

Duration: 0 Days
Attendees: 0+
Format: Hands-on
Status: Completed
Download Brochure

About This Event

The SAGE UI/UX Design Challenge – Awards Ceremony marks the culmination of an intensive, multi-stage national-level design challenge organized by SAGE. The event celebrates innovation, creativity, and problem-solving excellence demonstrated by student designers across planning, execution, judging, and interview stages.

With participation from 49 teams and 131 students, and evaluation by an international panel of judges from India and the USA, the ceremony recognizes outstanding UI/UX solutions and honors contributors who exemplify design thinking and user-centric innovation.

Event Highlights

  • Multi-phase UI/UX Design Challenge (Planning → Execution → Judging → Interview)
  • Participation from 49 teams and 131 student designers
  • Evaluation by 6 expert judges from India and USA
  • Featured talk on future technologies and design impact
  • Awards, special recognitions, and participation certificates
  • Student–expert interaction and networking

Who Should Attend

Academicians and researchers | Industry professionals | Students of Electronics, Communication and allied disciplines | Entrepreneurs | Anyone interested in India’s technology and innovation ecosystem.

9:30 AM – 2:00 PM
MSRIT, Bengaluru

The UI/UX Competition Award Ceremony celebrates innovation and design excellence among students. It highlights top-performing projects and promotes creative thinking in interface design.

SAGE - BMSIT SYMPOSIUM

Event

August 1 & 2, 2025 (Friday & Saturday)
BMSIT, Yelahanka, Bengaluru

Duration: 0 Days
Attendees: 0+
Format: Hands-on
Status: Completed
Download Brochure

About the Symposium

The SAGE – BMSIT Symposium on RF MEMS is a two-day technical symposium jointly organized by Shastry Associates’ Global Enterprises (SAGE) and BMS Institute of Technology (BMSIT). The symposium focuses on the design, fabrication, and applications of RF MEMS in Biomedical systems, 5G and beyond communications, and Electronic Warfare systems.

The event brings together distinguished scientists from DRDO, IISc, CSIR-NAL, IITs, industry professionals, and academic leaders to discuss emerging technologies, indigenization challenges, and interdisciplinary research directions in RF MEMS.

Event Highlights

  • Two-day national-level symposium on RF MEMS and advanced communication technologies
  • Jointly organized by Shastry Associates’ Global Enterprises (SAGE) and BMS Institute of Technology (BMSIT)
  • Technical focus on Biomedical systems, 5G & beyond communications, and Electronic Warfare applications
  • Distinguished speakers from DRDO, IISc, IITs, CSIR-NAL, academia, and industry
  • Keynote address on next-generation RF MEMS technologies and interdisciplinary research
  • Industrial visit to SITAR, DRDO for real-world exposure
  • Platform for industry–academia interaction and collaborative research discussions
  • Free parking facility available for all participants

Who Should Attend

Academicians and researchers | Industry professionals | Students of Electronics, Communication and allied disciplines | Entrepreneurs | Anyone interested in India’s technology and innovation ecosystem.

About This Event

The First SAGE International Symposium on Advances in Wireless Technologies brings together leading researchers, academicians, and industry experts to discuss emerging trends in 5G, 6G, RF systems, microwave engineering, and semiconductor technologies. The symposium focuses on translating advanced research into real-world products and next-generation communication systems.

Key Themes

  • Evolution from 5G to 6G communication systems
  • RF, microwave, and millimeter-wave technologies
  • Semiconductor and SoC design challenges
  • Industry–academia collaboration and innovation

Who Should Attend

Academicians and researchers | Industry professionals | Students of Electronics, Communication and allied disciplines | Entrepreneurs | Anyone interested in India’s technology and innovation ecosystem.

About This Event

The Valedictory Function of the SAGE–RVCE–Keysight Hands-on and In-depth Workshop on 5G-Band GaAs FET RF Amplifier marks the successful completion of an intensive two-phase journey. Organized by Shastry Associates and Global Enterprises, RV College of Engineering, and Keysight Technologies, this workshop brought together 39 participants who completed the full RF design cycle—from theory and simulation to fabrication and real-world measurements.

Workshop Highlights

  • Complete RF amplifier design cycle from simulation to hardware testing
  • Hands-on measurements with Keysight professional equipment
  • Industry-level exposure bridging academia and real-world applications
  • Guidance from SAGE experts, DRDO & ISRO veterans, and industry engineers
  • Certificate distribution and felicitation of mentors and participants
  • Recognition of contributions from RV College, Keysight, and SAGE teams

Distinguished Chief Guests

Dr. K. D. Nayak (Former Director General, DRDO) | Dr. Surendra Pal (Former Associate Director, ISRO) | Prof. V. Mahadevan (Former ISRO Scientist, PES University) | Industry experts from Keysight Technologies | Faculty and coordinators from RV College of Engineering
